revisions.reason: Implementation review: discover project root in cmd_hook so subdirectory runs cannot misclassify in-repo files as outside-project-root; add hook.py to scope and two subdirectory tests
Root discovery must prefer .maid/ then .git over a nested manifests/ data folder (found running from maid_runner/core); add regression test
Re-review: ancestor .maid/ (e.g. ~/.maid) above a git repo hijacked root discovery and failed open; bound discovery by nearest .git, add ancestor-.maid and nested-repo tests

Third review: stray nested .maid/ inside a repo shrank the root and allowed repo files as outside-project-root under --strict; prefer git root when it holds .maid/ or manifests/; fixture repos get .git; document outside-project-root in README and docs/agent-skills.md

Fourth review: make a wrong root fail closed - anchor root on an absolute active manifest, require an active task for outside-project-root (restores 069-02 strict no-active-task deny), add bare-git-root boundary test
Fifth review: apply outside-project-root only after the active manifest loads so a wrong root fails closed; re-anchor on absolute manifests only when a project marker is found

Sixth review: drop heuristic root discovery (hook.py back to baseline); outside-project-root allow now requires the loaded active manifest to lie inside the project root so any root mismatch falls back to baseline
Seventh review: resolve() ValueError (embedded NUL) was classified as outside; treat any resolution error as unknown so it falls through to the normal decision; docs wording matches README
Eighth review: containing the manifest is not ownership (root at repo/manifests allowed repo files); require the manifest under the root's manifests/ directory
Ninth review (ready): document cross-checkout/nested-project behavior as a known limitation; description-only change
